featured_reviews.name: Maithilee Warang
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ashram is really good I kept my nani, and I must say it is a very peaceful and caring place for elderly people. The environment is calm, clean, and well-maintained, which makes the residents feel comfortable and safe.

The food provided at the ashram is very good and healthy. Meals are served on time and are freshly prepared, keeping in mind the health and dietary needs of the elderly. The staff members are kind, patient, and always ready to help the residents with anything they need.

The care given to everyone here is truly heart-warming. The staff regularly checks on the residents and makes sure they are comfortable, happy, and healthy. They treat everyone with respect and affection, almost like family.

One of the best things about this ashram is the positive and friendly atmosphere. The residents spend time together talking, sharing stories, and supporting each other. They often play devotional songs and music, which creates a peaceful and spiritual environment. Sometimes they also sing together, celebrate small festivals, and enjoy group activities that keep everyone engaged.

The place is very clean and organized, with proper rooms, good ventilation, and peaceful surroundings. It truly feels like a home rather than just an institution. When we kept our nani her weight was very low she wasn't healthy but because of ashram she became very healthy and strong

Overall, this ashram is a wonderful place for elderly people to stay. It provides good food, proper care, companionship, and a peaceful lifestyle. I feel happy knowing that my nani is in such a loving and supportive environment.

featured_reviews.review_text: It's said life after 60 is kind of a new life for everyone. From being independent, most of us turn to our family, relatives, kids etc. on whom we are dependent on multiple things. To have these elderly people in our midst is always a blessing in disguise since not only they have ways to entertain us, but also their immense knowledge and undivided care and love and affection. Some of these mesmerizing people who do not have the liberty of having their family near them in these days - god provides them with a miracle by providing them with a home and caring people. Alpha Seniors Home is one such place where the elderlies can find peace, joy to live their years and also an opportunity for people like me to visit and spend time and bask in the memories and knowledge gained over the years.  Great place to be and definitely worth spending time and visiting time and again.

We at Alpha Seniors Home do believe that life is full of happiness with proper catalysts in it like cleanliness, various activites, tasty food, and also proper mental and physical health through exercises and professional help. featured_reviews.name: Nirav Majgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text: My overall experience with this place has been very satisfactory. We needed a place for one of our uncle’s as he was advised utmost care post his leg surgery and I must say Mr. Amis Lopes and his team did an excellent job. He recovered very well during his 3 months stay and is very happy now. This place is an absolute peace of mind for the elderly. Highly recommend this for our beloved senior citizens.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Our joy knew no bounds when Dear Prabhakar uncle recovered magnificiently. It was a great honour to serve him. Uncle was very friendly and humorous. Thank you again for your words of appreciation, it's really a great encouragement for us.

featured_reviews.name: B D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with Alpha was shocking - a nightmare - very disappointing.

We heard of Alpha Care Home in 2022. At that time it looked like the best place for our family member. But within 1 year we faced serious problems.

Biggest issue is that Alpha does not have 24-hour caretakers. For a place with so many elderly & medically unfit people, this is unacceptable. All carehomes must have 24 hour help and monitoring.

There is also no proper introduction between the residents. There is no separation of people based on their needs. People with mental health problems and those bed ridden are kept together with normal people. This is extremely unsafe.

One night, our family member was locked out of his room until 2 a.m. His roommate, who had mental issues, did not allow him to enter. We told Amis Lopes, but no action was taken. Our complaint was conveniently ignored.

Later, a much worse incident happened. Our family member was beaten. He was hit, pushed against a wall, and his face was swollen. His glasses and hearing aids were damaged. At that time, nobody was present to help. Amis Lopes was out of town, and there was no helper or caretaker.

Unacceptable & a serious matter. Amis Lopes was liable for a police case & interrogation, due to his negligence and inadequate staff our family was injured. Such incidents are a crime in a care home.

Alpha is an unclean and overcrowded care home with no 24-hour care staff. The owner is kind in the beginning during admission and payments, but later was completely disappointing and untrustworthy.
